reviewer: Kimi Code recovery review subagent actually viewed the full exact source, complete unchanged raw, full white/cyan/source-alpha/return-alpha comparison sheet and naiwa reference; inspected native-resolution fedora, eyewear, moustache/mouth, pipe and collar details and verified evidence/source/output/prompt/task/request/result/sheet SHA-256 and image-metadata bindings with read-only Python

entries.positive_observation: The brown fedora retains its dark band, broad brim, dim brown crown light and source crop. Native detail confirms the visible image-left circular spectacle rim/catchlight and green-ringed black eyes in deep shadow, without added white sclera, human nose, ears or skin. The broad dark moustache and one curved smoking pipe projecting toward image right remain, with a single pipe-occupied mouth area and no second mouth. The image-right three-quarter bust, low-key illumination, raised dark overcoat collar and faint shirt/tie shapes remain. Native collar crops show continuous head/neck contact without a long neck column, floating cloth or cream bib. The complete dark brown/charcoal backplate retains its subdued gradient and vignette without a cutout, frame, note, halo or replacement interior.
entries.alpha_decision: Approve the RGB art only for a later source-alpha BILINEAR repair. The unchanged return is RGB with returned_alpha_extrema=null, while the source is RGBA with extrema [243,255]; it is not yet approved for production. The complete raw and white/cyan/source-alpha/return-alpha sheet show no visible backing loss, holes, haze or transparent corners. No alpha repair was performed in this review.
entries.visible_limitations: Deep source shadow does not resolve the full glasses frame, eyebrows, hairline/sideburns, gaze, beard/chin, expression or fine shirt/coat construction. No exact match is claimed for those hidden features. The visible fedora, spectacle rim/catchlight, moustache silhouette, pipe, raised collar and backing were checked directly; unresolved shadow detail alone was not used as a rejection reason.
